slides.title: Some messages are tricks
slides.text: Some messages look friendly and exciting, but they are tricks. They want you to hurry, or to give away something private.
slides.alt: A prize card from Prize Team, marked unknown sender: “You won a tablet!”

focus.cue: Big, exciting words: You won a tablet!
It wants your mailbox key, fast

slides.title: Clues of a trick
slides.text: Look for clues. It says hurry, or it promises a prize you never tried to win. It asks for your passphrase. It comes from someone you do not know.
slides.alt: The prize card's cues: hurry, only ten minutes; asks for the mailbox key; a prize you never entered; says congratulations. Then the three choices.

focus.cue: A prize you never tried to win

slides.title: Trick or safe?
slides.text: This message has three clues: a scary threat, a rush and a request for your key. It is a trick.
slides.alt: A card from "Your bank", unknown sender: your account is locked, send your mailbox key today. Two cues are already found.

focus.cue: A scary threat: your account is locked
A rush and a request: your key, today

slides.title: What to do
slides.text: Real companies never ask for your passphrase. Do not reply or tap, and tell a trusted adult. A trick that fishes for secrets is called phishing.
slides.alt: Cues found on the bank card: threatens to close, asks for the key, unknown sender. Then: Safe, Trick or Ask a trusted adult.

focus.cue: Not sure? Ask a trusted adult

slides.title: Secret codes for fun
slides.text: A cipher wheel turns letters into a secret code. Shift each letter by 3 and A becomes D. Only someone who knows the key can read it.
slides.alt: The cipher wheel on shift 3: the secret message DSSOH reads APPLE.

focus.cue: The wheel shifts every letter by 3
DSSOH, read with the key, is APPLE

words.means: a message that tries to fool you
a trick message that fishes for your secrets
a way to turn a message into a secret code
the secret that unlocks a code

slides.title: Pim's piece lights up
slides.text: Three pieces lit. Pim bows, and the Spark glows brighter still. One world is left: Gizmo the mouse is waiting inside the machine, where everything is very, very small.

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Packet Post at Spot the Trick and check all 6 cards. Tap every clue you find, then choose. After that, the game sends you to Secret Messages: crack the 2 messages there with the key wheel.
slides.alt: A prize card from Prize Team, marked unknown sender: “You won a tablet!”
